title: ICON 2024 Toyota Tacoma 1.25-3in Stage 9 Suspension System - Billet (w/ Triple Rate Spring)
body_html:
ICON Vehicle Dynamics 2024-2026 Toyota Tacoma suspension systems are designed with maximum performance and the serious driver in mind. ICON engineers’ primary focus is to increase wheel travel and damping ability, which translates into outstanding vehicle control and ride quality both on- and off-road. This Stage 9 system includes vehicle-specific tuned 2.5 Series coilover shocks featuring CDXS equipped remote reservoirs and ICON-engineered coil springs for superior vehicle “feel” through the range of travel. Remote reservoirs greatly increase shock oil volume and heat dissipation surface area to resist overheating and cavitation under hard use, which can lead to damper fade. Stage 9 also features ICON's exclusive Compression Damping Dual Speed (CDXS) valves for precisely dialing in your suspension performance. CDXS controls fluid flow under compression, with independent adjustability of high speed and low speed compression force. 10 discreet detented settings for both low and high-speed adjustment knobs allow separate adjustments for handling response and overall aggressiveness. These coilovers are also height adjustable from 1.25-3” of front lift height over stock, allowing the use of larger, more aggressive wheel and tire combinations. The front differential drop brackets and ICON’s specifically designed coilover lengths maximizes the available front suspension travel and prevent CV bind. Additionally, polyurethane differential mounting bushings replace the soft OE bushings to help limit differential movement under load.

ICON Vehicle Specific (V.S.) 2.5 Aluminum Series shocks are designed and built to give your vehicle outstanding performance off-road and a smooth ride on the street. These shocks are configured specifically for each application in both length and damping tune. Like all ICON'S Shock Absorbers, V.S. 2.5 Aluminum Series shocks are fully rebuildable and re-tunable. The ICON CDE Valve upgrade is included for those desiring an easy way to tune the ride electronically from inside the vehicle. Compression Damping Electronic Valve (CDEV) is an electronically controlled valve that meters the flow of oil to regulate the amount of damping force that is created by the shock when compressed. This infinitely variable valve can react in less than 40ms and has the ability to make extremely precise adjustments for varying terrain. CDEV's hydraulic circuits are also custom tailored per application to create the highest resolution and dynamic range allowable for each specific vehicle. Powered by ICON Intelligent Control and proprietary ICON mobile app, the system uses information from the onboard G-force sensor and Gyroscope to perform calculations based on algorithms and user-defined settings to predict terrain and adjust shock settings via the CDEV accordingly. For piggyback and specific remote reservoir applications, ICON'S unique use of a 6061-billet aluminum manifold a few inches below the top cap of the shock creates an internal Bump Zone that when used creates an additional 20% of damping force. This additional force helps prevent harsh bottom outs and controls the suspension when compressing at high velocity.

K&N charge pipe kits are made of free-flowing, mandrel-bent aluminum tubes designed to replace the restrictive factory intercooler piping on specific turbo charged vehicles and offer a wide range of performance customization options. K&N charge pipes have been engineered to reduce turbo charged air pressure loss as well as dramatically increase air flow from the turbo through the intercooler. The charge pipes are constructed from lightweight aluminum with a durable gunmetal gray powder coated finish. title: DEI Exhaust Wrap EXO Series - 0.5in x 20ft - Tan
body_html: EXO Series exhaust wrap solves the problem of extreme exhaust heat in extreme environments like offroading and powersports. EXO Series exhaust wrap is designed for extreme environment use. Traditional exhaust wraps have not been able to withstand the extreme use that Off-road, Dirt track, Desert and other forms of driving have with exposure to water and dirt. The EXO Series is a dual-layer design, using a combination of hi-temp glass fiber, covered with a 304 grade stainless steel exoskeleton. This unique construction maintains high heat protection while offering superior abrasion and impact protection. Our unique Air Gap Technology keeps direct contact of the glass fiber wrap off the hot surface creating an insulating air barrier. The EXO Series exhaust wrap comes in a special 1.5 in. width, making it easy to install on any type of header, exhaust pipe or exhaust system making it perfect for high impact spot protection. In addition, the stainless steel exoskeleton locks together when overlapped keeping the wrap tight and making installation easy. Delivering outstanding looks and Rugged performance for long term durability, available in Black or Tan in either 1.5 in. x 10ft, 20ft, or 30ft rolls.

title: AWE Tuning 2021+ GMC Suburban/Yukon XL 5.3L 0FG Split Rear Exit Catback - Quad Diamond Blk Tips
body_html: The 0FG Exhaust for the Chevrolet Suburban, Chevrolet Tahoe, and GMC Yukon/Yukon XL is a 3” T304L stainless steel catback configuration featuring a front pipe that begins directly after the factory emissions equipment, paired with a tailored mid muffler and resonator combination for a deep, rich tone. Engineered for both standard and XL wheelbase models, the 0FG delivers refined V8 tone, precision fitment, and signature 4.5” double-walled tips in chrome silver or diamond black. U.S.-sourced .065”-wall T304L stainless steel runs from front to back, CNC mandrel-bent for smooth flow and handcrafted in-house for exacting quality. The straight-through design keeps restriction low while the tailored mid muffler and resonator balance exhaust pulses for a deep, clean soundtrack with the right amount of aggression. The 0FG Exhaust is available as a split rear exit configuration with quad tips for models equipped with bumper cutouts, or a side exit configuration with dual tips for models with flat bumpers.

title: SuperPro Land Rover-Sprg/Up/Bush
body_html: These bushings are often overlooked when upgrading the suspension of a 4WD. Leaf spring bushings stabilize the movement of the rear axle, inferior bushings in this area will cause the solid rear axle to move and impart rear end passive steer to the vehicle. It also causes the vehicle to 'wander' all over the road and be unstable under heavy braking. This can be especially noticeable carrying a load or towing a boat or caravan. The OE rubber style bushings are designed to work at standard height with standard tires and with standard loads. By fitting SuperPro Bushings and upgrading to Greaseable Shackles the rear end of your 4WD will handle just about anything you can throw at it!

Control arm bushings form the vital pivot and link between all core suspension components. SuperPro's 'offset' bushing options introduce additional positive caster into the front end suspension geometry. With a small but significant change the additional caster delivers several benefits: Improved straight-line stability and tracking; your vehicle will track straight and return to center with less driver input. Dynamic camber gain with steering angle “ the more your turn the wheel with additional caster the more both wheels will ˜camber' into the turn putting more of the tire's contact patch on the road as the suspension loads up in the corner and helping to resist the tire ˜rolling over' onto the shoulder and compromising grip. Enhanced steering weight and feel; the small caster change will weight up the steering slightly as you come off-center and the improved cornering grip delivers greater feel for the handling limit through the wheel. The caster offset bushings deliver only benefits with no negative impact on tire wear, comfort or unwanted handling behavior. SuperPro's polyurethane bushings are the culmination of nearly 5 decades of suspension expertise and development in Australia's harshest terrain. Designed with durability as a paramount feature we also bring ride and passenger comfort to the forefront of our development. K&N intakes are designed to dramatically reduce intake restriction as they smooth and straighten air flow. This allows your engine to inhale a larger amount of air than the factory air filter assembly. More air means more usable power and acceleration throughout the engine's RPM range. The 57-3022-2 air intake comes with a K&N high-flow air filter that is mounted to a heat shield that installs into the previous air box space behind the radiator. Air is directed past the mass air sensor through an aerodynamically engineered intake tube into the engine's throttle body for a guaranteed power gain. The tube accommodates the factory air temperature sensor and, for vehicles equipped with an air injection, the air injection hose onto which a vent filter is attached to. The oversized oval tapered air filter can be used for up to 100,000 miles before servicing is needed depending on driving conditions. This air intake is relatively easy to install usually in 90 minutes or less using the existing factory mounting points. The tools needed are a screwdriver, ratchet set, knife and a wrench. K&N 57 Series FIPK's are street legal in all 50 US states and come with K&N's Million Mile Limited Warranty.

ICON Vehicle Dynamics V.S. 2.5 Series remote reservoir front coilover shocks are an incredible upgrade for the front end of the 2005-2023 Toyota Tacoma. These adjustable coilovers allow up to 0-3.5” of lift height adjustability on 2005-2015 models or 0-2.75” of lift height adjustability on 2016-2023 models, allowing the use of larger, more aggressive wheel and tire combinations. ICON’s Vehicle-specific shock length and valving along with the larger 2.5” shock body and increased piston area over stock components yield the maximum travel possible along with superior ride quality and suspension performance both on- and off-road. Remote reservoirs greatly increase shock oil volume and heat dissipation surface area to resist overheating and cavitation under hard use, which can lead to damper fade. Their extended travel length allows for more wheel travel but also requires the installation of aftermarket front upper control arms. ICON's exclusive Compression Damping Dual Speed (CDXS) valves are included for precisely dialing in your suspension performance. CDXS controls fluid flow under compression, with independent adjustability of high speed and low speed compression force. 10 discreet detented settings for both low and high-speed adjustment knobs allow separate adjustments for handling response and overall aggressiveness. To better support the weight of additional accessories such as aftermarket front bumpers and winches, these coilovers include ICON engineered coil springs with an increased, 700 lbs/in spring rate, allowing for taller ride heights with increased front end weight. title: Mishimoto 15-20 BMW F8X M3/M4 Performance Auxiliary Radiator
body_html:
The 2015-2020 BMW F8X M3 and M4 rely on auxiliary radiators mounted low in the front corners of the car to keep the S55 in its operating window. Under sustained track use and aggressive street driving, the factory units run out of cooling capacity and heat-soak between runs - and their low position leaves them exposed to road debris and the plastic end tanks prone to cracking under repeated heat cycling. The Mishimoto Performance Auxiliary Radiator replaces the stock unit with a larger, fully reinforced aluminum core engineered to add thermal headroom and survive the conditions that retire the OEM part early.----The core carries 9% more volume and 32% more external tube area than stock, rejecting more heat into the airstream when the engine is working hardest. Strutted tubes reinforce the core against the vibration and impacts that fatigue a low-mounted radiator, while removable stone guard shields the exposed face from debris. Aluminum, TIG-welded end tanks replace the failure-prone factory components, and a robust bracket design fits both the driver and passenger-side locations from a single part.----Direct fit for the 2015-2020 BMW F8X M3 and M4 - installs in the factory auxiliary radiator location with no cutting, fabricating, or adapter work required. Backed by the Mishimoto Lifetime Warranty.

A 63% increase in core volume over the OEM radiator delivers greater surface area and thermal capacity, keeping coolant temperatures stable during back-to-back pulls, spirited street sessions, and weekend track days where the stock radiator starts to fall behind.----Designed as a direct-fit replacement for the 2012-2015 Honda Civic Si, this radiator drops in without cutting, fabricating, or modifications, and works seamlessly with all stock hoses and components without alteration. The included high-pressure radiator cap maintains optimal system pressure from the first drive, extracting the full benefit of the upgraded core. The Mishimoto Magnetic Drain Plug catches ferrous metallic debris before it circulates through the cooling system, protecting your K-series engine internals and extending service life beyond what the factory setup allows.----Don't wait for your stock radiator to crack and leave you sidelined. Whether you daily drive your Civic Si, push it hard on weekend canyon runs, or are building toward a higher-output K-series setup, this aluminum radiator handles the sustained thermal demands your factory unit was never built for. Proactive cooling upgrades protect your engine investment - and this one is built to outlast it. title: MagnaFlow MF/R Series 5in Round 304SS Performance Exhaust Muffler
body_html: The MagnaFlow 17169 MF/R Series 5 in. Round body is a purpose built competition muffler kit engineered to survive and perform in the most demanding high output race environments. Its design and durability have been proven through extensive real world race testing conducted in collaboration with Camburg Engineering and validated under aggressive competition conditions by Camburg Racing. Its straight through perforated core, stainless mesh wrap, and continuous roving high temperature insulation fill form a two stage packing system designed to maintain unrestricted flow under sustained heat and pressure while controlling the distracting NVH that slows drivers down, verified through professional testing by Camburg Racing. Single piece billet 304 stainless steel TIG welded end caps with integral V band flanges deliver uncompromising rigidity, leak proof reliability, and the kind of mechanical stability required for repeated wide open throttle abuse. The 16 gauge 304 stainless steel tubular body features internal expansion capability and 3 in. / 3 in. connections, enabling 17169 to handle extreme exhaust mass flow, shock loading, and high cycle thermal stress without fatigue or performance fade. Fully reversible, it integrates cleanly into diverse layouts where packaging, flow direction, and thermal management are critical. Professional installation is recommended, and users should verify compliance with local noise regulations. For installation, the kit includes keyed flanges for precise orientation and V-band clamps for a secure, repeatable seal. Built from corrosion resistant 304 stainless steel and manufactured using CNC robotic precision welding, the MagnaFlow 17169 MF/R Series is a race proven, competition grade muffler kit engineered with direct input from off-road racing professionals and designed for teams and drivers who demand uncompromising performance.

title: Comp Cams Camshaft Kit, Cs 275Deh
body_html:
Fits Chevrolet GEN 1 Small Blocks including the 262, 265, 267, 283, 302, 305, 307, 327, 350 and 400. Does not fit LT1/LT4, or factory roller Small Blocks built from 1985 and newer. GM gradually added roller camshafts to 305's and 350's from the mid 80's forward. Camaros/Firebirds/Corvettes received the roller cams early, but many trucks and SUV's had flat tappet cams until the mid 90's. Remove the intake or timing cover to confirm whether the block is a factory roller or flat tappet. Does not fit the LS1, LS2, LS3 or any LS-based 4.8, 5.3, 5.7, 6.0 and 6.2. 1955-1957 Chevrolet 265 engines require a groove on the 5th cam journal for oiling. Contact us for more information.

title: ACT 07-18 BMW 3.0L Turbo (N54/N55) Mod-Twin 225 HD Sprung Street
body_html:
T1SS-B01 Mod-Twin 225 HD Sprung Street Kit is designed for high powered AWD street cars. It unites uncompromised pedal feel, durability, engagement quality with very high torque capacity by combining twice the organic friction surfaces with an ultra-durable spring center Mono-Drive hub in a completely modular design. Each diaphragm spring endures an exclusive four-stage heat treating process providing a consistent light pedal feel. Steel-backed Friction Plates with high quality organic friction materials deliver stable friction coefficient, good heat capacity and long clutch life. These Friction Plates uniformly transfer torque to the Mono-Drive sprung hub assembly which extends input shaft life and reduces driveline shock from torsional vibration. This kit includes a CNC-machined and dynamically balanced flywheel, pressure plate cover, diaphragm spring, face, puck-style ceramic friction plates, sprung Mono-Drive hub assembly, floater, patented Monoloc Collar, release bearing, alignment tool and pilot bearing (if needed). Mod-Twin clutches are fully rebuildable and most components can be ordered separately.

title: Yukon Gear Ball Joint Kit for AAM 9.25in Front Differential
body_html:
Superior materials lead to superior performance. When you replace and upgrade your failing OE ball joints with a heavy-duty Yukon unit you get a ball joint built to the highest standards of quality and durability. Its housing is CNC-machined from forged SAE 1045 carbon alloy steel and the ball stud is made from induction heat-treated, hot-forged 4140 chromoly. These ball joints use military-grade acetal bearings because of their advanced anti-friction properties and dimensional stability. Ball joints are only as durable as the protection provided by their rubber boots. Yukon ball joints feature a two-staged approach with a synthetic Neoprene/CR outer boot and an inner seal/pancake boot that safeguard the spherical joint and bucket against gritty road grime, oil, gas, and engine fluids, and extreme temperatures. This kit replaces the upper and lower front ball joints on both sides and includes Grade 8 hardware, castle nuts, c-clips, cotter pins, and zerk fittings.

title: Yuasa YTX20HL Maintenance Free AGM 12-Volt Battery
body_html:
Unleash unrelenting starting power and ultimate dependability with the YTX20HL Maintenance Free AGM 12-Volt Battery. Specially engineered for high-demand powersports applications, this high-output battery cranks out a massive 310 Cold Cranking Amps (CCA) to ensure immediate, punchy engine ignition every time you push the starter button. Yuasa’s specialized radial grid structure and extra internal plates supply up to 30 percent more cranking power than standard AGM batteries, making it the perfect upgrade for large-displacement V-twins, heavy touring motorcycles, ATVs, and personal watercraft that demand maximum electrical muscle.Built with advanced Absorbed Glass Mat (AGM) technology, the YTX20HL captures electrolyte completely inside porous microfiber glass separators to create a fully sealed, leak-proof, and spill-proof unit once activated. This permanently sealed design eliminates the hassle of routine fluid checks and topping off with water while delivering superior resistance against extreme engine vibration and trail shock. Heavy-duty lead-calcium grid construction holds a charge up to three times longer than traditional batteries during offseason storage,

title: Timbren 15-20 Chevrolet Suburban/GMC Yukon XL BES Severe Duty Semi-Metallic Brake Pads - Rear
body_html:
When your truck is at maximum GVWR, your brake pads are your primary defense against the physics of a heavy load. Timbren BES OnyxBite™ Brake Pads are a severe-duty upgrade designed specifically for the 1% of truck owners who actually put their vehicles to work. Unlike standard ceramic pads that prioritize low dust over stopping power, the OnyxBite™ formula uses a high-friction, low-metallic compound. This ensures a firm, responsive pedal and a significantly stronger "bite" the moment you hit the brakes, which is critical for reducing stopping distances when towing a trailer or boat.The OnyxBite™ compound is engineered for thermal stability, resisting the "glazing" that occurs when lesser pads are pushed past their limits. To ensure a premium driving experience, these pads feature multi-layer rubber shims and precision chamfers that dampen harmonic vibration and eliminate the squeal often associated with heavy-duty friction materials. They are fully compliant with 2025 copper-free environmental standards, providing modern performance without compromise. Each set arrives with a complete stainless steel hardware kit to ensure a noise-free, professional installation. By choosing OnyxBite™, you are investing in a brake pad that thrives under the high-torque demands of hauling, backed by Timbren’s 42-month or 42,000-mile warranty for long-term peace of mind.

title: Timbren 2000 Toyota Tundra SES Spacer Kit
body_html:
Popular Timbren SES kits were designed to work on pickup trucks with a standard ride height. But installing a lift kit on your pickup truck will increase the distance between the frame and the rear leaf spring and, therefore, compromise the effectiveness of the Timbren SES helper springs. In other words, your lifted truck is still going to squat even after a Timbren SES rear kit has been installed. That's where an approved Timbren spacer kit can fill the gap. This spacer kit will enable you to haul your gear with confidence even if your lifted Toyota Tacoma or Toyota Tundra has approximately 6.00" - 7.50" of space between the frame and the rear leaf spring. Here's how it works: Each spacer kit comes with two 1 inch and two 1/2 inch spacers along with all the necessary hardware. This handy little kit helps you mix and match the spacers when you add them to the Timbren SES assembly allowing you to achieve your desired ride height. Whether you've got a leveling kit, body lift or full suspension lift, Timbren spacer kits allow you to make effective use of your Timbren SES kit while hauling or towing your gear. How Do I Know If I Need a Spacer Kit? To determine whether you need a spacer kit, measure between the frame and rear leaf spring of the truck when empty. If the gap between frame and axle for your Toyota Tacoma or Toyota Tundra is approximately 6.00" - 7.50" you will need to order a spacer kit.

title: Timbren 2015 Ford F-150 SES Spacer Kit
body_html:
Popular Timbren SES kits were designed to work on pickup trucks with a standard ride height. But installing a lift kit on your pickup truck will increase the distance between the frame and the rear axle and, therefore, compromise the effectiveness of the Timbren SES helper springs. In other words, your lifted truck is still going to squat even after a Timbren SES rear kit has been installed. That's where an approved Timbren spacer kit can fill the gap. This spacer kit will enable you to haul your gear with confidence even if your lifted Ford F250 has approximately 9.00" - 10.50" of space between the frame and the rear axle. Here's how it works: Each spacer kit comes with two 1 inch and two 1/2 inch spacers along with all the necessary hardware. This handy little kit helps you mix and match the spacers when you add them to the Timbren SES assembly allowing you to achieve your desired ride height. Whether you've got a leveling kit, body lift or full suspension lift, Timbren spacer kits allow you to make effective use of your Timbren SES kit while hauling or towing your gear. How Do I Know if I Need a Spacer Kit? To determine whether you need a spacer kit, measure between the frame and rear axle of the truck when empty. If the gap between frame and axle for your Ford F250 is approximately 9.00" - 10.50" you will need to order a spacer kit.

Responsible for anchoring the sway bars and facilitating proper function and body control of your vehicle the OEM rubber bushings are tasked with quite a job and in-turn wear quickly compromising the effectiveness of your sway bar and contributing to a loose, sloppy feeling on the road over time. SuperPro's sway bar mount bushings are designed to fit the OEM designed hardware and mountings - no generic one-size-fits all bushings and cheap universal hardware here - each bushing is designed to integrate into the factory suspension design and function. title: Fabtech 19-20 GM C/K1500 P/U w/Trail Boss/At4 Pkg 4in Basic Sys w/Perf Shks
body_html:
The Chevrolet Trail Boss and GMC AT4 both have a factory 2 in. lift compared to other GM 1500 trucks of the same year model. Fabtech's suspension system for these two trucks provide a 4 in. lift height on top of the factory 2 in. lift for clearance of 35 in. tall tires. Once a Trail Boss or AT4 is lifted with a Fabtech 4 in. system, the truck will sit the same height as a 1500 with a 6 in. suspension and 35 in. tires. Fabtech's suspension design for the Trail Boss and AT4 provides excellent drive ability both on and offroad. There is zero bump steer throughout the suspension cycle that helps reduce drive fatigue while improving the overall drive ability of the vehicle. The near stock track width keeps the tires under the fenders for a clean appearance. Fabtech's proprietary steering knuckle geometry provides excellent lock to lock turning radius to maneuver in tight spots. Heavy duty 1/4 in. thick steel crossmembers feature OE style alignment cam pins that utilize the factory cams for easy adjustment. Triple front diff mounts reposition the differential for vibration free operation at high speed. The factory Trail Boss and AT4 coilover shocks are retained and relocated from the bottom to allow for full steer while achieving 4 in. of lift. Rear lift is accomplished by removing the factory 2 in. block and replacing it with a 5 in. block and u-bolt system. Fabtech has addressed all aspects of the Trail Boss suspension for proper wheel travel and lock to lock steering without over cycling. Comes with a free 5 year 60,000 mile Powertrain Warranty.

title: FAST Precision Flow LS2 Style Fuel Injector (90lb/hr) - Single
body_html: These new injectors deliver the outstanding idle quality, unparalleled flow consistency, and durability essential for high-performance EFI applications. Engineered for excellent response and fuel atomization, FAST Precision-Flow fuel injectors are manufactured and 100% flow-tested to maintain the industry's tightest tolerances. With flow rates from 30 to 245 lb/hr, these will meet the fuel demands of high-horsepower engines and are compatible with all fuels. These injectors undergo a multi-point dynamic flow test that holds them to within +/- 2% of the stated flow rate across a set of 8 injectors. Testing at multiple pulse widths, rather than just at static flow, ensures consistent cylinder-to-cylinder fuel delivery across the entire engine operating range, not just at maximum capacity. The result is a smoother operating engine that is easier to tune and maintain a consistent cylinder-to-cylinder air/fuel ratio. Available as single injectors or in sets of 8, these FAST Precision-Flow fuel injectors will be the final piece of your fuel delivery system in any EFI-equipped application.

It comes with a giant 4 in. diameter aluminum remote reservoir that mounts horizontally above the Coilover to allow for full compression travel with oversized tires. The rear suspension receives a 5 in. lift block, extended bump stop brackets and Dirt Logic 2.25 shocks for a balanced ride quality. This 4 in. title: DV8 Offroad 2017+ Ford F-250/F-350/F-450 Front Bumper
body_html:
FBFF2-03 2017 to present Ford F-250/350/450 Front Bumper. The DV8 Offroad FBFF2-03 front bumper is designed to provide exceptional protection at a fraction of the weight of ordinary steel bumpers. Although these bumpers are made with 3/16 inch steel and 1/4 inch reinforcements throughout, DV8 shaves every pound possible off the bumper with strategic cutouts and mesh aluminum grills that can be removed and color matched to the vehicle. DV8 also integrates 3 LED light holes into the bumper for improved visibility. This bumper has 2 shackle recovery points and is designed to accommodate up to a 16,000 lbs. winch. The 3 piece design allows for easy replacement if one of the pieces is damaged in an accident and also provides the opportunity to swap out the end pieces for a different style i.e. Baja, plate, high clearance etc. DV8 Offroad did not sacrifice style or functionality when making these bumpers modular. Every bumper uses razor thin adjoining edges to keep the full-size bumper look and brackets that extend from the bumper ends to the frame where necessary to provide excellent strength and rigidity. This bumper comes powder coated in a sand texture black finish. This finish can be left as is or can be sanded down and painted over to color match the bumper to the vehicle. Key Features: Lighter than ordinary steel bumpers, Every bit as rigid as a one piece bumper, Cut outs for 2 LED Pod Lights (DV8 p/n B3CE16W4W), Cut out for one 6 inch LED Light Bar, Accommodates up to a 16,000 lbs. winch, 2 Shackle recovery points, Modular design allows for customization, Sand texture powder coat finish, Mesh inserts can be color keyed to vehicle, Lights Not Included.

title: Comp Cams Chevrolet 348/409 Big Block Evolution Retro-Fit Hydraulic Roller Lifters - Set of 16
body_html: COMP Cams Evolution HCT (Hydraulic Cartridge Technology) is a new patented tappet.  The Evolution HCT tappet provides most consistent performance of any set of lifters in the aftermarket. A combination of self-contained hydraulic cartridge and accompanying reduced oil volume that is less effected by oil aeration delivers the most consistent bleed rates between each lifter. The smaller volume within the hydraulic cartridge creates one of the most responsive and quietest lifters on the market. Startup noise is greatly reduced and a precision controlled bleed down rate ensure excellent performance at high RPM. The patented cartridge design also allows for an incredibly stiff lifter body, greatly reducing body distortion and further ensuring consistent hydraulic performance. This patented HCT tappet is not just a performance Original Equipment replacement. This is an all new bespoke design started from a blank canvas developed to meet the demanding performance and durability our customers desire.Also, as an industry first the hydraulic element of this patented lifter is serviceable, allowing anyone to rebuild their lifters in their own garage.

title: Banks Power 07-10 Chevy 6.6L LMM Ram-Air Intake System
body_html:
Largest filter area for superior high-flow filtration and fewer filter cleanings. Exclusive 5 inch bellows accommodates engine movement and prevents component damage. Cooler temps, more power and MPG, plus a cleaner-running engine. Testing, testing & more testing. Banks Ram-Air Intake Systems are tested and proven. They start out as CAD software prototypes and are put through flow simulations. After a hardware prototype is made, it's tested on a flowbench. Then it's tested on the vehicle. And finally, Banks' density-tests the Ram-Air against stock and many competitors. Proven design. Proven performance. Thanks to its enclosed cold-air housing, huge inlet, giant dome-shaped filter and streamlined design, Banks Ram-Air Intake maximizes the flow of cool, dense air to the engine for greater power and fuel economy. It flows 47% better than stock. And delivers greater air density to the turbo's inlet than the stock system and every competitor tested! Add on the optional Super-Scoop, and the results are even better! It's all about density. And Banks Ram-Air Intakes deliver. The harder you work your truck, the more Banks Ram-Air Intake improves power and fuel economy! Longer service life, too. An aftermarket exclusive: with 5" bellows, Banks Ram-Air accommodates engine movement, which protects the components and extends service life. What's more, Ram-Air is designed to not cause fault or error codes. Key Features: Enclosed housing keeps out hot, power-robbing engine air. Extends service life and requires fewer cleanings. Inhales cooler outside air for more power & MPG. Giant filter maximizes high-flow filtration. Reduces exhaust gas temps (EGTs). Accommodates engine movement. Extensively tested & validated. title: aFe Sprint Booster Power Converter Mazda 3 22-25 L4-2.0L/2.5L/2.5L (t)
body_html:
Automobiles in the 21st century have replaced the more conventional throttle cable technology for an ECM (Electronic Control Module) that translates pedal travel into electronic signals in order to provide power to the wheels. The ETC system (Electronic Throttle Control), also known as drive-by-wire, has the unfortunate downside of delayed throttle response and subdued acceleration, creating problems in certain circumstances such as up-hill starts, quick gear changes, overtaking, etc. The Sprint Booster aims to overcome this throttle response delay for ETC-equipped vehicles, providing crisp on-tap acceleration at the driver's disposal. For vehicles with electronic control (ETC) systems, or drive by wire, this device plugs into the OE connector located behind the accelerator pedal. It's a simple installation, requiring no cutting of any wires or interference of the automobile's electronics. It does not affect other systems such as electronic injection, ABS, etc. The three main acceleration modes can be switched by pressing the main button. When the LED is off, the Sprint Booster is deactivated, and the car has factory settings. In Sport Mode, the LED is green, and throttle response is improved by up to 30%. With the red colored LED, the Sprint Booster is in Race Mode, and it improves response by up to 60%. Each acceleration mode comes with nine programs. Select 1-9 in SPORT mode and 1-9 in RACE mode, with '1' being the least aggressive program and '9' the most aggressive.

title: Timbren SES Spacer Kit (Use w/ PN DR1500DQ or DR1500DS)
body_html:
Timbren SES kits are designed to work on vehicles with factory ride height, allowing for a 1 inch space between the Aeon(r) rubber spring and your vehicle's suspension when unloaded. But if you have a leveling kit, body lift, or full suspension lift, the increased distance can reduce the performance of your SES kit. However, there is a way you can still enjoy a level, controlled towing experience with your lifted truck. How? Timbren SES spacer kits reduce the gap between the Aeon(r) rubber spring of an SES kit and the increased distance between your lifted pickup's frame and rear axle - enabling your Timbren SES kit to perform properly. Each spacer kit comes with two 1 inch and two 1/2 inch spacers, along with necessary hardware - so you can mix and match the spacers to achieve desired height.

title: KW H.A.S. Kit 25-26 BMW M5 Touring (G99) AWD Hybrid
body_html:
KW (H.A.S) Height Adjustable Spring kits are a great alternative to conventional lowering springs. You are no longer stuck with a fixed lowering height. KW H.A.S. systems allow you to adjust the vehicle ride height with the KW height adjuster even after the kit has been installed. Your vehicle not only gets a more dynamic look, but also the steering behavior and response of the standard dampers becomes more agile. All driver assistance systems and comfort features of a factory adaptive or electronic suspension remain operational and work harmoniously with our vehicle specific spring set up. KW uses high-quality springs made of chrome-silicon steel with spring rates designed specifically for each respective OE suspension damper and wheel load. KW's expertise and engineering ensure the spring rates will pair perfectly with the different damper characteristics of your factory adaptive electronic suspension. Along with the use of high quality materials and the included KW ride height Adjustment - mechanisms, our KW H.A.S. kits always includes the vehicle-specific bump stops with dust protection system to protect your factory suspension against wear & tear caused by road grime and debris. Similar to a coilover suspension, the KW H.A.S kit allow a continuous adjustable ride height within a tested range, something not possible with conventional lowering springs. The dust protection elements and spring perches included in the delivery, when applicable, are always adjusted to the maximum technically possible lowering, typically limited by the factory dampers. With KW height adjustable springs, a sporty and harmonious driving behavior can be achieved without the driving dynamics of performance-oriented vehicles suffering. As with all KW suspension products our engineers develop vehicle specific parameters and spring specifications which undergo comprehensive testing on the Nurburgring Nordschleife and in our KW 7-post Driving Dynamic Test Center.

body_html:
Consisting of a pair of specially-designed bolts, H&R patented "Triple C" Camber Adjustment Bolts replace the original upper fastening bolts on McPherson strut applications. As the bolt is turned, a small cam eccentric alters the vehicle's camber, allowing adjustments from 0-3 degrees, posiTUVe or negaTUVe. When you lower a vehicle's ride height, negaTUVe camber is increased ? how much depends on the vehicle and the reduction in ride height. H&R "Triple C" Camber Adjustment Bolts are a simple, yeTUVery effecTUVe means of removing excessive camber, adjusting your vehicle's camber settings, or even correcting small side-to-side camber variations for precise alignment. Installation takes only minutes with readily available hand tools, and benefits include increased tire life, improved tracking and the ability to dial in more camber for weekend track events.

body_html:
H&R Trak+ Wheel Spacers move your wheels out so they are flush with the fender-instantly giving your vehicle the perfect stance. Whether you want improved handling, increased safety, or simply want your car to make a statement about your individual style, Trak+ Wheel Spacers can help you accomplish your goal and GO WIDE. Manufactured from a special proprietary alloy that has a higher tensile strength than 6061-T6 billet aluminum, H&R Trak+ Wheel Spacers are hubcentric featuring a full contact hub-just like the factory hub-for even load force distribution and lateral support.

title: Fabtech 03-08 Dodge 2500/3500 4WD Diesel Front Dirt Logic 2.25 N/R Shock Absorber
body_html:
The best shocks only get better with all new Stainless Steel and Aluminum construction. High grade 304 Stainless Steel shock bodies eclipse all other shocks on the market for maximum corrosion resistance. Each Stainless Steel shock body receives a finely detailed machine finish for a stunning appearance. Dirt Logic Stainless Steel reservoir shocks have been upgraded with black anodized 6061 Aluminum reservoir bodies. This includes both piggyback and remote reservoir shocks. The Aluminum resi construction allows for greater heat dissipation thereby keeping the shock cooler to reduce fade during aggressive offroad use. Finally each Dirt Logic piston rod has been upgraded to a NitroSteel(R) material that is super hard while providing increased corrosion resistance compared to chromed piston rods. Get the finest ride with maximum corrosion resistance only from Dirt Logic shocks. In addition to the specific Dirt Logics for each suspension system, there is also a line of universal Dirt Logic shocks available in reservoir and non-reservoir styles, ranging from 8 to 16 inches of stroke. These universal shocks are sold with universal hardware kits for easy installation. Dirt Logic 2.0 and 2.25 shocks feature urethane bushings in the mounting points to reduce road noise and rattling associated with spherical bearings. Dirt Logic coilover shocks utilize spherical bearings at each end for increased strength along with urethane misalignment cups in the top caps. The misalignment cups keep the road noise transferred through spherical bearings to a minimum. Dirt Logic 2.5 and 4.0 coilover shocks use coil springs made to the highest quality standards possible. All Dirt Logic coils posses the ability to go solid without breaking, settling or bowing. All Dirt Logic coilover shocks come preset with the proper amount of preload so they can be bolted on without any further adjustment necessary. Dirt Logics are available with or without an external reservoir.

body_html: Edelbrock Supercharger System #15666 is a bolt-on forced induction kit that features significant improvements for 2019-2021 Chevrolet/GMC 1500-series trucks with the 6.2L V8 engine. This kit is emissions-legal in all 50 states and provides a 44% increase in horsepower to 548 RWHP with a 36% increase in torque to 505 ft-lbs at the rear wheels when used with the supplied calibration and 3.75-inch pulley on 93-octane pump gas. An Edelbrock Supercharger is the perfect power adder whether you plan to tow a boat, haul heavier loads, or you just want to feel your truck come to life without sacrificing daily drivability. Edelbrock Supercharger Kit #15666 for Chevy/GMC trucks features a redesigned lid with more clearance under the cowl for easier installation and a restyled badge lets people know that your system is Made in the USA by Edelbrock. Installation of the Edelbrock Supercharger requires no cutting or modifications and fits neatly under the stock hood. If you're concerned about the effect on MPG, the increase in power comes with little to no loss in fuel economy during normal driving thanks to the system's integrated bypass valve that mitigates parasitic power loss. This is a true bolt-on kit that requires no additional modifications to the stock 6.2L engine. The Edelbrock Supercharger features a self-contained lubrication system with a 100,000-mile service interval and a patented high-capacity Dual-Pass 3-Core (DP3C) intercooler. The durable black powder-coating blends nicely with the engine and results in an attractive underhood presentation that looks like the factory put it there. Each kit includes a complete set of preformed hoses, hardware and a full-color manual that provides clear step-by-step instructions for ease of installation. Unlocking of the factory PCM is included in this kit. Covered by Edelbrock's industry-leading 3-year/36,000-mile powertrain warranty.

title: Edelbrock AVS2 650 CFM Carburetor Electric Choke - Chrome Plasma Finish
body_html:
Edelbrock's AVS2 #1906-CP with Electric Choke is a special Chrome Plasma finished 650 CFM street carb with Annular Flow Booster technology for near-EFI-like drivability that you can feel as soon as you step on the gas. The AVS2 1906-CP features an annular ring with eight evenly spaced orifices that replaces the standard single brass tube (down-leg) fuel feed. The AVS2 booster ring distributes fuel into the airflow stream with an even spray that eliminates flat spots and greatly improves throttle response in the low-to mid-RPM range without sacrificing top-end power. The Chrome Plasma finish is applied is a 7 stage process to ensure the most durable and brilliant finish possible. The AVS2 is unaffected by engine backfires since there are no power valves to blow out. For fast and simple part-throttle tuning, metering rods and springs can be changed in seconds without carburetor removal or fuel draining. AVS2 carbs have the unique ability to hold a tune when compared to other carburetors. Your tuning and adjustments stay unchanged, so performance remains consistent. Updated primary and secondary booster clusters in the AVS2 offer the most accurate and up-to-date calibration available for today's fuels and octane levels. Additionally, the unique Qwik-Tune Secondary Air Valve allows for limitless calibration of the secondary circuit. Adjustments can be with simple hand tools in seconds to suit your application. AVS2 Carburetors feature a two-piece design for easy tuning that allows you to make float level adjustments or replace internal components without draining the carburetor or removing it from the engine. The 1906-CP AVS2 650 CFM comes with an electric choke and is manufactured by Edelbrock in the USA.

Cometic MLS (Multi-Layer Steel) Head Gaskets provide maximum sealing performance for todays high output engines and require no sealants. MLS gaskets are ideal for both aluminum heads to aluminum blocks and aluminum heads to cast iron blocks. They can withstand the shearing force created by the two materials. MLS gaskets have increased strength because they are comprised of multiple layers of stainless steel; which also creates the ability to rebound and resist corrosion. The outer layers are embossed and coated on both sides with Viton (a flour elastomer rubber based material that is heat resistant to 250 C/ 482 F). Viton is designed to meet the demands of a variety of harsh sealing environments, load conditions, and surface finishes. The center or shim layer is uncoated stainless steel, which can be varied to accommodate multiple thickness requirements.

Note: In limited cases, the factory downpipes have been known to emit minor rattling noises when paired with the AWE S4 exhaust system. title: Air Lift Performance 3H (3/8 Air Line 4 Gal 5-Port  Polished Aluminum Tank VIAIR 444C Comp)
body_html: We asked ourselves, what would the ultimate air suspension be like? How would it combine an easy-to-use, reliable, and feature-rich system with powerful technology and beautiful design? Air Lift Performance 3H is the result of three years of development and testing. It is the most advanced product we have ever created.  Air Lift Performance 3H combines pressure-based control with ride-height sensing technology. While both types of air management have been utilized before, this is the first product to harness the benefits of both systems, instantly improving suspension control, performance, and vehicle ride flexibility.

title: Timbren 22-26 Toyota Tundra/22-24 Lexus LX600 BES Coated Brake Rotor - Front
body_html:
Timbren BES Severe-Duty Rotors are engineered to solve the most common failure point in heavy-duty braking: heat. When hauling heavy equipment or campers, standard rotors often break down because of thermal stress, leading to warping, pedal pulsation, and dangerous brake fade. Timbren addresses this with OnyxBond™ technology, a proprietary matte black finish that provides a superior barrier against both corrosion and extreme temperatures. While typical zinc-coated rotors fail as temperatures rise, OnyxBond is rated for 932 degrees Fahrenheit, offering a 67% higher heat threshold to keep your braking performance consistent mile after mile.Beyond heat management, these rotors are manufactured for professional-grade smoothness. Each unit is fly-cut balanced to eliminate the vibrations and "shudder" that often occur during high-torque stops. The protective OnyxBond™ layer also serves as a robust defense against road salt and moisture, ensuring that the cooling vanes remain clear of rust and debris for maximum longevity. Designed as a precision, direct-fit replacement for your factory equipment, these rotors allow for a straightforward installation that immediately upgrades your truck's reliability. Whether you are navigating job site traffic or long highway hauls, the Timbren BES rotor provides the structural integrity and thermal recovery needed for the most demanding towing applications.

title: Power Stop 21-24 Ford Edge Front Z17 Coated Brake Kit
body_html:
PowerStop is on a mission to deliver an easy way for any driver to upgrade their brakes - no matter where or how they use their vehicle. Our Z17 Evolution Geomet Coated Rotor Brake Kit includes brake pads, rotors, and stainless-steel hardware; everything you need for the affordable, easy replacement brake kit for your daily-driven vehicle. The Z17 Evolution pads feature a low-dust formula, validated through on-vehicle 3rd party tests in the USA, to keep your wheels looking like new. These pads also have multi-layer rubberized shims that insulate noise for virtually silent braking. The rotors are treated with a thin layer of Genuine GEOMET 360 coating to protect against rust and corrosion without diminishing braking performance, and are manufactured to original equipment specifications. If you're looking to refresh the look and braking performance of your old, worn-out brakes, look no further. Say hello to a smooth, quiet commute with the Z17 Evolution Geomet Coated Rotor Brake Kit.

title: Pedders 13-24 Subaru BRZ / 17-25 Toyota 86/GR 86Rear EziFit SportsRyder Spring and Shock
body_html:
Pedders has played a prominent role in the Australian automotive aftermarket industry 1950. In the summer of 2006 Pedders USA became a reality by selling specialised parts to automotive wholesalers and specialist workshops throughout the U.S. By 2010 Pedders USA had established industry partnerships with GM, Lingenfelter, Richard Petty and Saleen. Pedders has been featured on TV with West Coast Customs and in magazines such as Supercar builder. For each new chassis Pedders USA develops an integrated and engineered suspension solution. There is no fixed formula. Its not an exact science. Our people identify the weaknesses in the OE suspension and develop Pedders components to correct them. We think like OE engineers, but without interference from sales, marketing and finance. We manufacture our Pedders parts to suit the automotive enthusiast and offer a comprehensive range of suspension components for most of the vehicles on the world's roads today, from AMC to Wolseley, with just about everything in between. We started in the USA with the fastest wide-body GTO on a road course. Next the fastest Chrysler 300C. Then Pedders USA's G8 and 5th Generation Camaro. When we moved to Ford, the results with the Saleen Mustang were the same. Our 'supercars' are developmental vehicles with purpose. We upgrade everything to make certain that we are testing at or above the levels of performance our customers will reach. We document every step of our development in enthusiast forums so they can benefit from our hard work. Ride quality is subjective. Our test cars serve as daily drivers. As we do our R & D work in AU and in the USA, the goal is to achieve a Pedders feel: the ideal balance between civility and performance handling. Pedders USA does not build parts for race cars. We make parts for the enthusiast driver that just happen to do extremely well on the race course. A fully Pedderised vehicle feels like a factory hot rod. It is quiet. It is comfortable. It handles.

body_html:
The McLeod RST HD Clutch Kit is engineered for performance enthusiasts who demand more holding power than stock while maintaining excellent street manners. Positioned between McLeod's renowned RST and RXT twin-disc systems, the RST HD delivers an ideal balance of drivability and performance enthusiasts with a more spirited driving style.At the core of the RST HD are dual performance discs design that maximizes both versatility and torque capacity. One side utilizes full-face organic friction material for smooth engagement durability under repeated street and strip use. The opposing side features segmented ceramic friction material, providing increased bite and enhanced holding power when performance demands rise.This hybrid friction combination enables the RST HD to withstand aggressive driving conditions while preserving the street-friendly characteristics McLeod customers expect. It is an ideal solution for high-horsepower vehicles that see daily street use as well as weekend track duty.Available in multiple configurations, the RST HD can be paired with an existing compatible flywheel using ringed versions or purchased as a complete package with a dedicated aluminum or steel flywheel for optimal performance and fitment.Designed for drivers seeking the perfect balance between comfort and capability, the McLeod RST HD is a versatile twin-disc clutch solution rated for up to 950 horsepower.

title: KYB JAOS 10-14 Toyota FJ Cruiser/10-20 4Runner Rear Suspension Lift Kit
body_html:
The KYB JAOS Suspension Lift Kits provide up to a 2 inch lift as well as 14 position damping. The adjustable dial at the base of each shock and strut allows for 14 different rebound and compression settings. The 14 settings allow the user to manually adjust the suspension for vehicle loads, larger wheel and tires and road conditions. The front struts also have adjustable spring seats to allow height adjustments to the front of the vehicle. Each kit comes complete with two shocks or struts and two coil springs. It is recommended to utilize both front and rear kits when making this upgrade.

title: ICON 2020+ GM 2500/3500 HD 0-2in Stage 1 Suspension System
body_html:
Tougher, stronger and more capable - That's the motto that General Motors used when debuting the all-new fleet of heavy-duty trucks in 2020. ICON Vehicle Dynamics stayed true to GM engineers' thought process with the development of our suspension systems for the 2020-UP GM HD 2500/3500 trucks. Using ICON's holistic engineering philosophy, our R&D team went above and beyond to develop several stages of complete suspension systems that provide varying levels of adjustability, capability, and overall vehicle performance. ICON's Stage 1 system is comprised of V.S. 2.5 Aluminum Series internal reservoir front shocks, 2.0 Aluminum Series internal reservoir rear shocks, and billet aluminum Delta Joint upper control arms. The ICON vehicle specific tuned 2.5" front shocks are the key to attaining optimum ride quality and getting that desired comfort with the 3/4 & 1-ton working capability. Additionally, ICON billet upper control arms add strength, durability, additional caster and camber adjustment, and when paired with extended travel shocks increases wheel travel 2" over the OEM configuration. While driving the construction site or trails to your favorite dirt bike location, ICON wants you to get there in comfort just like your drive to work.

title: Icon 21-23 Ford F150 (4WD) Stage 3 Suspension System w/ Billet UCA
body_html:
This system features upper control arms with ICON's patented Delta Joint. The Delta Joint is a heavy duty high angle ball joint that combines the durability of a ball joint with the performance characteristics of a traditional uniball. While the industry standard uniball does a great job of allowing the control arms of a vehicle to articulate with little bind, they do have an inherent weakness that leaves more to be desired when used in a daily driven application - exposure to the elements. The Delta Joint features a zinc plated housing providing the first layer of corrosion resistance, while a tough grease seal keeps potentially harmful elements out of the inner workings of the joint. Metal on metal construction and a greasable design increase the longevity of the Delta Joint while at the same time allowing for noise-free operation. What makes the Delta Joint unique is that it brings the best of both worlds to ICON upper control arms with features that make it more robust than a uniball, and at the same time capable of greater angularity than a typical ball joint.

title: ICON 07-09 Toyota FJ / 03-09 Toyota 4Runner 2.5 Series Shocks VS RR CDCV Coilover Kit
body_html:
ICON Vehicle Dynamics V.S. 2.5 Series remote reservoir coilover shocks are an incredible upgrade for the front end of the 2003-2009 Toyota 4Runner, 2007-2009 Toyota FJ Cruiser, or 2003-2009 Lexus GX470. ICON’s Vehicle-specific valving provides a sport tuned feel on and off-road while offering 0-3.5” of lift height adjustability for use of larger, more aggressive wheel and tire combinations. The larger 2.5” shock body and increased piston area over stock components provides improved damping ability and outstanding ride characteristics across varying types of terrain. Remote reservoirs ensure optimum performance by increasing the duration of consistent damping regardless of situation, keeping the shocks at a cooler operating temperature during heavy use. ICON's exclusive Compression Damping Control Valves are included for precisely dialing in your suspension performance. CDCV controls fluid flow under compression, allowing you to achieve the perfect tune whether driving on the street, slow-crawling through the rocks or mobbing across the desert at full throttle. When paired with ICON rear 2.0 Aluminum Series rear shocks, vehicle control will be balanced front to rear resulting in the best overall driving experience for your 4Runner, FJ, or GX.

title: ICON 2005+ Toyota Tacoma 2.5 Custom Shocks VS RR CDCV Coilover Kit w/Procomp 6in
body_html:
ICON Vehicle Dynamics V.S. 2.5 Series remote reservoir front coilover shocks are an incredible upgrade for the front end of the 2005-2023 Toyota Tacoma equipped with the Pro Comp 6” lift kit. These coilovers offer lift height adjustability, allowing fine tuning of ride height or the use of larger, more aggressive wheel and tire combinations. ICON’s Vehicle-specific shock length and valving along with the larger 2.5” shock body and increased piston area over stock components yield the maximum travel possible along with superior ride quality and suspension performance both on- and off-road. To better support the weight of additional accessories such as aftermarket front bumpers and winches, these coilovers include ICON engineered coil springs with an increased, 700 lbs/in spring rate, allowing for taller ride heights with increased front end weight. Remote reservoirs greatly increase shock oil volume and heat dissipation surface area to resist overheating and cavitation under hard use, which can lead to damper fade. ICON's exclusive Compression Damping Control Valves are included for precisely dialing in your suspension performance. CDCV controls fluid flow under compression, allowing you to achieve the perfect tune whether driving on the street, slow-crawling through the rocks or mobbing across the desert at full throttle. When paired with ICON 2.0 or 2.5 Aluminum Series rear shock absorbers vehicle control will be balanced front to rear, resulting in the best overall driving experience for your Toyota Tacoma.

title: Corsa Apex 14-17 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 5.3L MaxFlow 5 Metal Intake System
body_html:
CORSA Performance APEX Series Intake Systems offer a free-flowing high performance alternative to your restrictive stock intake. Featuring Dynamic Flow Technology (DFT), APEX series intakes unlock performance gains from your engine. By carefully analyzing and understanding the air path to the engine and engine operation under a range of driving conditions, CORSA Performance engineers designed and created air ducts to maximize air delivery. Each air intake is constructed to maximize flow velocity, air volume and density by utilizing precise cross-sectional areas that remove restrictions, unleashing horsepower and torque. Every APEX Series intake is system-matched with an oversized air filter to maximize air flow and reduce maintenance intervals. APEX Series intakes are finished to enhance the appearance of any engine bay utilizing a durable black wrinkle coat that will stand up to a lifetime of use. CORSA Performance APEX intake systems install quickly (most under 30 minutes) and come complete with step by step installation instructions.

Specifically tuned for the HEMI V8, this system produces a deep, commanding tone at cold start and an intense roar under acceleration—bringing out the full character of the engine. Designed for maximum performance, it outflows the factory exhaust by up to 74%, reduces weight by 13 lbs, and increases volume by 18 decibels. This is CORSA’s most aggressive system, built for drivers who want their truck to be heard and felt. Constructed from premium 304 stainless steel, the system is built to endure extreme conditions and long-term use. It features CORSA’s signature dual-wall exhaust tips, available in Satin, Black Powder Coat, or Gunmetal PVD finishes for a custom look.Proudly made in the USA, every CORSA exhaust system is backed by a Lifetime Warranty—delivering both performance and peace of mind.

title: Comp Cams Hose Clamps, 16-25 Mm 5/8-1
COMP Cams Ford Small Block Cam & Lifter Kit FS 283TH HR07 Thumpr
body_html: The COMP Cams Thumpr camshaft delivers a signature lopey idle, strong low- to mid-RPM torque, and improved horsepower, making it ideal for street/strip builds seeking aggressive sound, throttle response, and classic muscle performance. Designed for high-performance street applications, it provides an unmistakable idle quality while pairing exceptionally well with popular upgrades like the Edelbrock RPM Air Gap intake manifold and TCI Saturday Night Special torque converter. Built withfull-size base circles for added durability, this cam works seamlessly with COMP Cams Evolution hydraulic roller tappets and eliminates the need for dog bones and lifter retainers—components never intended for pre-1985 applications. This camshaft supersedes part number CL31-600-8, delivering proven performance and simplified valvetrain compatibility in one upgraded design.

title: COMP Cams Xtreme Race G2 Pushrod 8.325in Length 5/16in DIA .106in Wall 210 Radius - Single
body_html: The COMP Cams Xtreme Race G2 series pushrods provides a high-stiffness valvetrain solution. This precision-formed, high-strength pushrod is designed to minimize deflection under elevated valve-spring loads and high-RPM operation, ensuring stable lifter-to-valve motion and maintaining accurate valve timing across the operating range. Engineered from premium 4130 aircraft-grade seamless chromoly steel and built around a stout 5/16-inch diameter, these one-piece, centerless-ground pushrods deliver uncompromising stiffness—dramatically cutting deflection and outperforming stock components when the power comes on. Precision-machined 210-degree radius tips ensure the rocker arms clear even the most aggressive high-lift camshafts, preserving razor-sharp valve timing and consistent lifter preload when your cam profile demands more. A durable black-oxide finish fights corrosion and helps retain vital oil at contact points, making the Xtreme Race G2 pushrods a true race-ready upgrade built to thrive in hard-driven street builds and demanding track environments.

title: Timbren 21-24 Cadillac Escalade/Chevrolet Suburban/GMC Yukon BES Coated Brake Rotor - Front
body_html:
Timbren BES Severe-Duty Rotors are engineered to solve the most common failure point in heavy-duty braking: heat. When hauling heavy equipment or campers, standard rotors often break down because of thermal stress, leading to warping, pedal pulsation, and dangerous brake fade. Timbren addresses this with OnyxBond™ technology, a proprietary matte black finish that provides a superior barrier against both corrosion and extreme temperatures. While typical zinc-coated rotors fail as temperatures rise, OnyxBond is rated for 932 degrees Fahrenheit, offering a 67% higher heat threshold to keep your braking performance consistent mile after mile.Beyond heat management, these rotors are manufactured for professional-grade smoothness. Each unit is fly-cut balanced to eliminate the vibrations and "shudder" that often occur during high-torque stops. The protective OnyxBond™ layer also serves as a robust defense against road salt and moisture, ensuring that the cooling vanes remain clear of rust and debris for maximum longevity. Designed as a precision, direct-fit replacement for your factory equipment, these rotors allow for a straightforward installation that immediately upgrades your truck's reliability. Whether you are navigating job site traffic or long highway hauls, the Timbren BES rotor provides the structural integrity and thermal recovery needed for the most demanding towing applications.

title: Mishimoto 2020+ Chevrolet / GMC Duramax L5P 6.6L Transmission Cooler
body_html:
The factory transmission cooling on the 2020+ Chevrolet and GMC Duramax L5P 6.6L is sized for stock duty, and fluid temperatures climb fast under the sustained load of towing and heavy hauling. Heat is what wears a transmission out. The Mishimoto Transmission Cooler attacks the problem with raw capacity: a tube-and-fin core with a 245% increase in core volume over stock, giving the system far more headroom to keep fluid temperatures in a safe range when the truck is working hardest.----The core also adds a 137% increase in frontal area, putting more of the cooler directly in the incoming airstream, and a 173% increase in external fin area to move heat from the fluid into the air more efficiently. All-aluminum construction handles the thermal demands of stock and modified Duramax trucks alike, and the cooler retains the factory transmission line connections for a clean, complete upgrade with no additional adapters or plumbing.----Direct fit for the 2020+ Chevrolet and GMC Duramax L5P 6.6L. No drilling, cutting, or modification required. Backed by the Mishimoto Lifetime Warranty.

Edelbrock part #7581-CP RPM Air-Gap 351W intake manifold is designed for street and high performance 351-427 c.i.d. 351W Ford V8 applications. The RPM Air-Gap incorporates the same race-winning design that's been used on our Victor Series competition intakes for decades. The Air-Gap design features an open air space that separates the runners from the hot engine oil resulting in a cooler, denser charge for more power. Larger cross sectional area and a taller carb flange than #7181 for compatibility with large displacement, stroker 351W based engines. Includes bosses for nitrous and rear water crossover. Edelbrock carbs will work with Ford automatic overdrive trans (AOD) when used with Lokar bracket SRK-4000, for more info call (865) 966-2269 or go to www.lokar.com.

Switch colors using the factory fog light switch, with no additional selector required. Cycle the lamps on and off three times to enter programming mode. title: DBA 16-20 Lexus GS F Front 5000 Series Slotted Rotor w/Silver Hat
body_html:
Sharing all the benefits of the 4000 Series, DBA's 5000 Series rotors are a composite 2 piece direct replacement brake rotor. DBA uses only the highest quality materials to ensure optimal performance under the most strenuous circumstances, combining high carbon cast-iron rings with aerospace grade aluminum hats (T6061-T6), held together with National Aerospace Standards (NAS) bolts and crimp nuts. The 5000 Series share all of the performance technology featured in the 4000 Series, with the added benefits of further weight reduction and improved heat management via aluminum hats. The use of aerospace grade aluminum hats reduces the unsprung weight of the brake rotors, while allowing for uniform radial disc expansion through the cast iron rings, and reduced heat transfer from disc to hub via the aluminum hats. DBA offers both complete assemblies for first time replacement (hats and flat discs bolted together) along with replacement hats and flat disc rotors (rings). This allows drivers to re-use their DBA 5000 Series hats with DBA replacement flat discs (rings). DBA recommends the 5000 Series for high performance street vehicles, track day and club racing and rally applications.

title: COMP Cams Ford Small Block Cam & Lifter Kit FS XE270 HR10
body_html: The COMP Cams Xtreme Energy camshaft delivers enhanced street performance for Ford Small Block engines, providing strong midrange torque and horsepower gains with a smooth idle and responsive throttle—ideal for mild performance upgrades. Designed with improved midrange power and a noticeable idle note, it pairs exceptionally well with popular combinations like the Edelbrock Performer RPM intake manifold and TCI Saturday Night Special torque converter (1600–1800 stall). Featuring full-size base circles, this camshaft works seamlessly with COMP Cams Evolution hydraulic roller tappets and eliminates the need for dog bones and lifter retainers—components never intended for pre-1985 applications. This camshaft supersedes part number CL31-432-8, delivering a reliable and balanced performance upgrade.

title: Comp Cams Ls Rocker Stud Kit (Studs And Nuts), M8 X 1.25 Stud, M8 X 1.25 Base Thread, 65Mm
body_html: This rocker stud and nut assembly allows for improved clamping load, adding up to a more rigid, stable and high revving valve train assembly. Additionally, it saves the threads in aluminum cylinder heads, especially in race applications that see constant disassembly. The stud kit also aids during installation of shaft mount rocker systems by accurately guiding the rocker arm assembly into position. The 12 point flange nuts provide ample clearance to rocker arms for maximum lift potential while a rounded nose on top of the stud prevents cross threading of the nut during assembly. Manufactured from grade 12.9 hardware, these high-strength studs also help to prevent thread fatigue and pulling of threads in aluminum heads.

title: COMP Cams Ford Small Block Camshaft FS XE258 HR10
body_html:
The COMP Cams Xtreme Energy camshaft delivers enhanced street performance for Ford Small Block engines, producing very strong torque and horsepower gains with a smooth idle and responsive throttle—ideal for mild performance upgrades and heavy vehicle applications. Engineered for excellent low- to mid-range power, it performs best with proven combinations such as the Edelbrock Performer intake manifold and a TCI Street Rodder or stock torque converter. Featuring full-size base circles, this camshaft works seamlessly with COMP Cams Evolution hydraulic roller tappets and eliminates the need for dog bones and lifter retainers—components never intended for pre-1985 applications. This camshaft supersedes part number 31-412-8, offering a dependable upgrade designed for improved drivability and consistent performance.

title: Clutch Masters Volkswagen R32 Aluminum Flywheel
body_html: Every Clutch Masters flywheel is proudly designed and manufactured in the USA. Flywheels are first designed in CAD and are then precision CNC machined in house in one of or Haas CNC lathes out of 6061 aluminum or 1045 steel billet cores. After machining, the flywheel is zero balanced to ensure it is evenly weighted on all sides and spins 100% true. Each aluminum flywheel is Type 3 Hard Anodized for the ultimate in durability and protection of the aluminum. All steel flywheels are black oxide coated to add a layer of rust prevention and gives our steel flywheels a unique black finish. The flywheel is then assembled by a Clutch Master Craftsman, double checked for imperfections and tolerances, and is then ready to be paired with one of our FX100-FX500 single disc clutch kits or twin disc options. All flywheels are SFI 1.2 Certified for use in motorsports.

title: ICON 21-23 Ford F150 2WD 0-3in Lift Front 2.5 VS Remote Reservoir CDEV Coilovers - Pair
body_html:
ICON Vehicle Dynamics V.S. 2.5 Series remote reservoir front coilover shocks are an incredible upgrade for the front end of the 2021-2026 Ford F-150 2WD truck. These adjustable coilovers allow up 0-3” of lift height adjustability, allowing the use of larger, more aggressive wheel and tire combinations. ICON’s Vehicle-specific shock length and valving, their large 2.5” shock body with increased piston surface area over stock components yield the maximum travel possible along with superior ride quality and suspension performance, both on- and off-road. Remote reservoirs greatly increase shock oil volume and heat dissipation surface area to resist overheating and cavitation under hard use, which can lead to damper fade. The ICON CDE Valve upgrade is included for those desiring an easy way to tune the ride electronically from inside the vehicle. Compression Damping Electronic Valve (CDEV) is an electronically controlled valve that meters the flow of oil to regulate the amount of damping force that is created by the shock when compressed. This infinitely variable valve can react in less than 40ms and has the ability to make extremely precise adjustments for varying terrain. CDEV’s hydraulic circuits are also custom tailored per application to create the highest resolution and dynamic range allowable for each specific vehicle. Powered by ICON Intelligent Control and proprietary ICON mobile app, the system uses information from the onboard G-force sensor and Gyroscope to perform calculations based on algorithms and user-defined settings to predict terrain and adjust shock settings via the CDEV accordingly. When paired with ICON 2.5 Aluminum Series CDEV rear shock absorbers, vehicle control will be balanced front to rear, resulting in the best overall driving experience for your Ford F-150 2WD.

title: ICON 2004+ Nissan Titan Alignment Cam Kit

The ICON Vehicle Dynamics Alignment Cam Kit provides a simple and effective solution for restoring and fine-tuning front suspension alignment on 2004-2024 Nissan Titan, 2005-2026 Nissan Frontier, 2005-2024 Nissan Armada, 2005-2015 Nissan Xterra, and other Nissan truck based applications. Replacing the factory non-adjustable lower control arm pivot bolts, these alignment cams allow precise caster and camber adjustments with the simple turn of a bolt, making alignment corrections quick and straightforward. Offering a total adjustment range of 4 degrees, from -2 degrees to +2 degrees, the kit provides the flexibility needed to properly align vehicles equipped with suspension modifications or to optimize factory alignment settings. Finished with a durable zinc plating for excellent corrosion resistance, the ICON Alignment Cam Kit is built to provide long-lasting performance in harsh environments while ensuring accurate, repeatable alignment adjustments for improved handling, tire wear, and overall drivability.

ICON Intelligent Control (IIC) is the computer that monitors, analyzes, and processes data in real-time. Information from the onboard G-force sensor and Gyroscope perform calculations based on algorithms and user-defined settings to predict terrain and wheel position. IIC has the capability to collect information at over 1000 times per second, process the data and make adjustments, then deliver those changes to Compression Damping Electronic Valve (CDEV) in the shock absorbers in under 40 milliseconds. IIC also works as a data driver to connect the user to ICON’s proprietary mobile App interface for monitoring and adjusting shock settings. The IIC is mounted to the 2020-2026 Chevrolet Silverado 2500/3500 HD or 2020-2026 GMC Sierra 2500/3500 HD using application specific mounting brackets, hardware and wire harnesses, ensuring an easy and clean looking install.

ICON Vehicle Dynamics V.S. 2.5 Series remote reservoir front coilover shocks are an incredible upgrade for the front end of the 2005-2023 Toyota Tacoma. These adjustable coilovers allow up to 0-3.5” of lift height adjustability on 2005-2015 models or 0-2.75” of lift height adjustability on 2016-2023 models, allowing the use of larger, more aggressive wheel and tire combinations. ICON’s Vehicle-specific shock length and valving along with the larger 2.5” shock body and increased piston area over stock components yield the maximum travel possible along with superior ride quality and suspension performance both on- and off-road. Remote reservoirs greatly increase shock oil volume and heat dissipation surface area to resist overheating and cavitation under hard use, which can lead to damper fade. ICON's exclusive Compression Damping Dual Speed (CDXS) valves are included for precisely dialing in your suspension performance. CDXS controls fluid flow under compression, with independent adjustability of high speed and low speed compression force. 10 discreet detented settings for both low and high-speed adjustment knobs allow separate adjustments for handling response and overall aggressiveness. When paired with ICON 2.0 or 2.5 Aluminum Series rear shock absorbers vehicle control will be balanced front to rear, resulting in the best overall driving experience for your Toyota Tacoma.

CDXS controls fluid flow under compression, with independent adjustability of high speed and low speed compression force. 10 discreet detented settings for both low and high-speed adjustment knobs allow separate adjustments for handling response and overall aggressiveness.

title: ICON 3.0 Master Shim Kit
body_html: The ICON Vehicle Dynamics Master Shim Kit is a comprehensive tuning solution designed for professional shops and suspension technicians who regularly service and re-valve ICON shock absorbers. Featuring a complete assortment of the most common valve shims used in ICON 3.0 Series shocks, the kit includes practically every available shim diameter in multiple thicknesses, providing the flexibility needed to fine-tune shock valving for a wide range of applications. Generous quantities of each shim allow multiple shocks to be serviced and re-tuned before restocking, reducing the need to purchase individual valve shims and improving shop efficiency. Organized in a convenient storage case for quick identification and easy access, the Master Shim Kit keeps critical tuning components readily available. Comprised entirely of genuine ICON Vehicle Dynamics components, this kit provides the quality, precision, and consistency required to achieve optimal shock performance with every rebuild or re-valve.

title: ICON 25-26 RAM 2500/3500 0-6in Lift Front Driveshaft
body_html:
Designed to handle the increased demands of lifted diesel-powered Ram HD trucks, this extreme-duty front driveshaft is engineered specifically for 2025-2026 Ram 2500 and 3500 4WD applications. Manufactured by Adams Driveshaft using premium Spicer and Neapco components, it delivers the strength, reliability, and driveline performance required for heavy towing, off-road use, and high-articulation suspension systems. Built to accommodate suspension systems ranging from stock height up to 6 inches of front lift, this driveshaft features a rugged 2.5-inch x .120-wall DOM steel tube construction for exceptional durability under the harshest operating conditions. A long, full-spline slip and stub assembly maximizes articulation and spline engagement throughout the suspension cycle, helping maintain smooth operation and dependable performance on and off the road. Equipped with the strongest solid, non-greaseable U-joints available, this driveshaft is designed to withstand extreme torque loads while eliminating the maintenance requirements associated with traditional greaseable joints. A heavy-duty OEM-style pinion flange ensures a straightforward installation and secure fitment, while included mounting hardware provides everything needed to complete the upgrade. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, this extreme-duty front driveshaft delivers the strength and confidence required for demanding Ram HD applications where factory driveline components may fall short.
